decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed office use would involve the loss of residential accommodation contrary to Section 3.37 of the written statement to the Greater London Development Plan which states:-"So long as an overall shortage of housing persists in London, planning permission will not normally be given for a change from residential use of any residential building that can still be used with or without adaptation, for residential purposes". It is not considered that any special circumstances exist in this case which would justify a departure from that policy.

Condition : 2 - The proposed office use would involve the loss of residential accommodation contrary to Policy P3.3 of the Merton Borough Plan and Policy H.01 of the Draft Reviewed Borough Plan which states that planning permission will not normally be granted for a change of use of any unit of residential accommdation that is in or can be improved to a satisfactory condition. It is not considered that any special circumstances exist which justify a departure from that policy.

Condition : 3 - Inadequate parking provision is proposed within the application site for use in connection with the proposed office use and residential unit which would exacerbate on street parking congestion in the locality, prejudicial to highway safety and detrimental to local amenities.

Condition : 4 - The proposed office use would constitute a consolidation and extension of a non-conforming use situated within a predominantly residential area to the detriment of amenities of occupiers of nearby residential properties.
description: CHANGE OF USE OF GROUND FLOOR OF PROPERTY TO OFFICES FOR USE IN CONNECTION WITH ADJOINING ROOFING CONTRACTORS YARD AND FORMATION OF A ONE BEDROOM FLAT AT FIRST FLOOR LEVEL.
